title: When the Salt Breaks Again
author: Sebastian Nakamura
blurb: Gideon Zhou, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
